content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?Kaye Zirk's PostKaye ZirkApril 13 at 7:36 AM · Shared with PublicBigbang's setlist on Coachella is really nostalgic like it’s not just a performance, it’s literally a throwback to every era that defined K-pop for so many people. Grabe, parang you’re reliving an entire generation in one night.Bang Bang BangFantastic BabySoberA Fool of TearsLoserHaru HaruLiesRinga LingaPowerGood BoyHando-choguaLook at me, Gwisson!Home Sweet HomeBad BoyWe Like 2 PartyStill LifeImagine hearing all these songs live in 2026 when it’s already been 20 years since Bigbang debuted and the crowd is still going absolutely insane like it just came out yesterday.This is exactly why they’re called LEGENDS OF K-POP. Not just because of what they did before, but because even now, in 2026, they can still own a stage and make it feel like the entire world is singing with them.CONGRATULATIONS ON YOUR FIRST COACHELLA PERFORMANCE, BIGBANG!!!
